newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Santos port to start full-time operations June 30.
newsitem.headline: Santos port to start full-time operations June 30.

text.p: Brazil's key port of Santos will start operating 24 hours a day starting June 30, allowing a faster transit of cargoes and creating cost savings for users, the port authority Codesp said in a statement.

"The measure is essential to adequately and efficiently attend to the need for a continuous flux of cargoes and to increase the volume of merchandise in Santos port," said Codesp president Marcelo de Azeredo.
Operations will take place in four or five shifts making up tranches of 18 or 24 hours, depending on the dock.
Continuous operation of the port was approved in March and has already been implemented in the soybean export terminal, a spokeswoman for the port said.
Other areas previously stopped work between 0100 local/0400 GMT and 0700 local/1000 GMT but will now also begin operating 24 hours, she added.
